title: Rules to regulate airfare framed, will be placed before parliament: Centre tells Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court on Monday directed the Central government to place before it a copy of the rules framed to regulate airfares in India [S Laxminarayanan Versus Union Of India And Ors.].A Bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta was hearing a petition seeking regulatory guidelines to control unpredictable fluctuations in airfare.The Court passed today's order after the Central government said that rules in this regard have already been framed.
